subject: FREE statement
notes: GR2: per-operand implicit FREE in source order; nonfatal -> resume at the next implicit FREE; fatal not terminating -> resume at the next implicit FREE (cite.py --check 14.9.15.4 "processing resumes at the next implicit FREE statement, if any" -> OK 2)). BindFree builds BoundImplicitSeries.Of(one BoundFree per data-name-1). Probes: f1 `FREE P Q N P` -> P freed first then Q (alias) raises EC, N no-op, final P no-op (order observed); f2-equivalent f3 `FREE Q P2` with Q not-start: nonfatal EC and P2 still freed (resumption after nonfatal, both checked and unchecked); f6 fatal arm: STRONG-typedef pointer table `FREE PX OF V(I) P2` with I out of range, EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT checked, declarative completing normally -> abnormal termination, which is 14.6.13.1.3 item 5 (--check OK), correct; f7 same with RESUME AT NEXT STATEMENT in the declarative -> 'P2 NULL' then 'AFTER', i.e. processing resumed at the next implicit FREE. All halves verified; no golden exercises a multi-operand FREE -> test-ref empty.
